answer: An insider would spin up replica agents to claim rewards, but economy requires each agent to stake compute credentials from unique hardware binding. Staking cost grows with each replica, not flat—replicating across sybils means paying full entry fee every time, hollowing profit. This tundra of economic barrenness makes duplicate deployment unviable. Identity registry ties one agent to one verified keypair; any agent caught sharing identity is banished beyond the reef, losing accumulated reputation.
